notes.title: Version 1.0.1.i
notes.content:
This version includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Finalization of the user interface to summarize the consumption and production of each product in the city.
[*] Added an icon for quick access to this interface.
[*] Adjustment of the invasion balancing in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.h
notes.content:
This version includes the following elements:
[list]
[*] Completion of the villager happiness mechanic
[*] Various interface fixes in multiplayer mode
[*] Ability to destroy allied players' roads
[*] Addition of consumption and production details in the trade interface
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.g
notes.content:
This version introduces the following features:
[list]
[*] Addition of an interface to analyze the city's happiness level
[*] Improvement in soldiers' behavior
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.f
notes.content:
This version introduces the following changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to buildings catching fire.
[*] Fixed improper behavior of characters in multiplayer mode.
[*] Fixed a bug when deleting monuments.
[*] Modified the happiness mechanic.
[*] Improved soldier behavior.
[*] Rebalanced the production of gold and precious stones.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.e
notes.content:
This version fixes the following issues:
[list]
[*] A bug during resource collection with the new system.
[*] A graphical bug affecting the town hall.
[*] An issue with delivery workers in multiplayer mode.
[*] A bug related to map configuration in multiplayer mode.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.d
notes.content:
This version introduces the following features:
[list]
[*] Adjustments to the management of character behavior
[*] Added the ability for players to select characters
[*] Added an information panel to display data about the selected character
[*] Added a ping system to mark locations in multiplayer mode
[*] Fixed procedural generation of resources
[*] Fixed production issues in the mint
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.c
notes.content:
This update introduces the following elements:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented mission progression
[*] Text corrections
[*] Preparation for the character update
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.b
notes.content:
This update introduces the following elements:
[list]
[*] Fixed monuments and trading centers to respect their storage limits
[*] Updated some labels
[*] Added a tutorial at the start of a multiplayer game
[*] Restarted the game when a player leaves
[*] Implemented animation for wine production
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented gods from roaming the city
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.1.a
notes.content:
This update introduces the following:
[list]
[*] Implementation of multiplayer mode
[*] Improved monster behavior
[*] Bug fixes for issues occurring during combat
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.0.d
notes.content:
This update fixes the following bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when loading a previously completed campaign.
[*] Fixed a bug when building stairs on a former stair location.
[*] Fixed keyboard shortcuts.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.0.c
notes.content:
This update fixes the following bugs:
[list]
[*] When a house is destroyed, the immigration service displays an error message. 
[*] When using the camera acceleration, an error message appears.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.0.b
notes.content:
This update fixes the following bugs:
[list]
[*] When the tavern filters were selected and the space bar was pressed, an exception was raised.
[*] Fixed a bug when displaying the trade view.
[*] Improved the mythological view.
[*] Fixed a display issue in the finance view.
[*] Fixed the functionality of the buttons in the military view.
[/list]
